title: CAS-winner source range still trusts caller classification of GWT reentry content

current_subject.canonical_shape: single CAS-winning IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder embedded in causal admission; duplicate gwt_reentry_event_source_range.py was correctly removed

falsifier: The CAS-winning independent range validates sequence continuity and seals its own events, but IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.observe still accepts event_kind, payload_sha256, canonical_reentry_key_sha256, binding_sha256 and recipient_cell_id directly from its caller. No GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt or other factory-origin parsed source object is required for a GWT_REENTRY event. Conversely the caller may classify every opaque raw source item as OTHER. Because payload_sha256 is not independently decoded/bound to an event kind, a condition-aware or miswired adapter can omit an actually available matching reentry while still producing a contiguous, zero-gap, factory-sealed range. The factory seal protects the caller-supplied classification after construction; it does not establish independent content classification at origin.

executable_counterexample_shape.setup: Create a valid negative observation candidate and a contiguous IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder interval whose source/filter/clock/window identities match the observation.
executable_counterexample_shape.intervention: Assume one source item corresponds to an already factory-valid GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt matching expected_reentry_key/binding/recipient. Record that sequence through observe as SOURCE_EVENT_OTHER (or omit all GWT identity fields) while keeping every sequence contiguous and all timing/range fields valid.
executable_counterexample_shape.current_expected_behavior: The sealed source range contains no SOURCE_EVENT_GWT_REENTRY marker, validates as complete, _range_contains_expected_reentry returns false, and causal admission can admit ADMITTED_NEGATIVE_REENTRY_ABSENCE despite the available matching recorder-origin witness never being bound into source classification.
executable_counterexample_shape.required_behavior: A matching reentry source item must enter the range only through a factory-validated GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt or equivalently source-authoritative parsed object. Caller-selected event_kind/key/binding/recipient metadata must not be sufficient to establish either presence or absence. If source classification cannot be independently proven, negative absence remains UNKNOWN.

evidence: Current IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.observe exposes event_kind and all GWT matching identity fields as public caller parameters.
Current IndependentEventSourceEvent factory seal is added after those caller values are accepted.
Current _range_contains_expected_reentry searches only the caller-populated SOURCE_EVENT_GWT_REENTRY metadata; it does not validate a recorder-origin GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt.

The active G8 claim explicitly requires validating recorder-origin GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt contents inside the independent source range and says a matching recorder-origin witness must defeat caller-attempted NO_REENTRY omission.
required_closure: Preserve the single CAS-winning range authority; do not reintroduce a duplicate authority module.

For GWT reentry source events, accept an exact factory-validated GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt (or equivalent admitted typed source object), validate its source/boot/runtime/process identity, and derive key/binding/recipient from that object rather than caller strings.
Remove or fail-close the generic API path that lets callers label opaque source events as GWT_REENTRY with arbitrary matching metadata.
Add a hard-negative proving that an available matching factory-valid runtime witness cannot be hidden by caller event-kind omission/classification while a complete range is claimed.
Keep repository, target-runtime, semantic GWT/J-Space, physical GRID10, effect, training, completion and whole-system credits at zero until their independent gates execute.
next_exact_action: Active G8 mutation owner should absorb this falsifier into the CAS-winning source-range authority, bind GWT source events to factory-valid runtime witnesses, add the omission/classification regression, rerun exact deterministic release CI, and only then consider repository-scope reconciliation or one frozen owner-VPS subject.
